Definition: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to scatter, be dispersed, be scattered; 1a) (Qal) to be dispersed, be scattered; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be scattered; 1b2) to be spread abroad; 1c) (Hiphil) to scatter; 1d) Hithpael) scatter; 2) (Qal) to flow, overflow; 3) to break; 3a) (Polel) to shatter; 3b) (Pilpel) to dash to pieces
